sentences.en: It is said that adolescent friendships do not often last.
sentences.zh: 据说青少年时期的友谊往往不会长久。

sentences.en: Impoverished, uneducated adolescents living in rural areas are most affected.
sentences.zh: 生活在农村地区的贫困、未受教育的青少年受影响最大。

sentences.en: Education about birth control might help cut down on adolescent pregnancies.
sentences.zh: 关于避孕的知识或许能减少青少年怀孕的情况。
